verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at the execution side of the story. Skills can bundle executable scripts (docs-66) and, via the API, run in a code execution environment (docs-10). Bundled skills can be disabled (docs-4), invocation is controllable through frontmatter and the Agent SDK (docs-34, docs-63), and custom API skills are private to a workspace (docs-12). Nothing in the pack is a dedicated security posture document. Missing for 10: a documented trust model or vetting process for third-party and marketplace skills, any telemetry or data-collection disclosure, an explicit statement of execution sandbox limits and permissions, and independent security review.
